findings.description: `stop()` adds `needs-manual-check`, but the fresh-ticket pickup and refusal paths do not clear it. If an owner closes a finished run’s pull request and retries the ticket, the label survives into the new run and can remain even when its acceptance criteria are all checked.
findings.title: Old manual-check labels mislead owners

findings.description: `stop()` derives unticked criteria from the worktree’s `pr-body.md`, but `checkAndPush()` does not publish that file when updating an existing pull request. When the agent changes acceptance checkboxes during a review round, the finished-run comment and manual-check label can disagree with the acceptance displayed in the pull request.
findings.title: PR acceptance diverges after reviews
